Fig. 2. Overall architecture of Q-TriM. First, question-guided token filtering keeps only the top tokens most relevant to the text and drops the rest. Next, Question-aware modality mixture computes four paths: TMA(Text,Audio,Video), TMA(Text,Video,Audio), CA(Text,Video,Video), and CA(Text,Audio,Audio). TMA stands for Tri-modal attention, and CA stands for cross-attention. Then questionconditioned weights are applied to the outputs. Finally, fused-feature reasoning combines these outputs and feeds the result to a classification layer to produce the answer.
